issues.failure_explanation: The proof replaces the convection part of A_h by -1/2 over all faces, but the defined A_h has -Σ_{E^i} ... -1/2 on the boundary. Thus the estimate does not bound Re A_h(u_h,u_h) for the stated form. The actual form has zero real convection part, so the lemma is true, but the proof as written is invalid.
issues.least_adequate_overall_repair: Use the actual A_h convection term in the proof; then Re of the convection part cancels, so coercivity follows from μ and the penalty term without the ε estimates.
issues.overall_effect: The proof of discrete coercivity does not apply to the defined DG form, leaving the well-posedness argument unsupported as written.
issues.title: Coercivity proof uses wrong convection term
issues.why_classification: A short local correction to the proof preserves the lemma and all downstream claims; no new argument architecture is needed.

issues.failure_explanation: The discrete adjoint equation has right-hand side \overline{\lambda_h^*}(v_h,u_h^*). Hence the strong adjoint residual is \overline{\lambda_h^*}u_h^* + μΔu_h^* + (β·∇)u_h^* - ∇p_h^*. The estimator uses λ_h^* u_h^* instead of \overline{λ_h^*}u_h^*. For complex eigenvalues this is not the residual, so the estimator and the subsequent bounds in Lemma 3-5 and Theorem 3-8 are incorrect for the complex setting.
issues.least_adequate_overall_repair: Replace λ_h^* u_h^* by \overline{λ_h^*} u_h^* in the estimator and correspondingly in the bounds, or explicitly assume all eigenvalues are real.
issues.overall_effect: The adjoint estimator and its reliability/efficiency estimates are invalid for complex adjoint eigenvalues.
issues.title: Adjoint residual estimator omits complex conjugates on λ*
issues.why_classification: The repair is a local insertion of complex conjugates and does not change the method or its convergence rates.

issues.failure_explanation: The corollary claims two-sided equivalence and eigenvalue reliability using only η_h^2 and η_h^{*2}. However, Theorem 3-4 for eigenfunctions includes the extra term ||λ_h u_h-λu||_0, and Theorem 3-8 for eigenvalues includes interpolation terms h^{2r}(...). The corollary neither retains these terms nor states assumptions that make them negligible. Thus the stated equivalences and inequality do not follow from the cited results.
issues.least_adequate_overall_repair: Add the missing extra terms to the corollary, or state and prove a saturation/regularity assumption that allows them to be absorbed by the estimators.
issues.overall_effect: The claimed clean equivalence between errors and estimators for eigenvalue clusters, and the eigenvalue estimator reliability, are unsupported.
issues.title: Corollary drops extra terms from reliability estimates
issues.why_classification: The corollary can be repaired by weakening it to include the omitted terms or by adding an extra assumption; this is more than a local typo but does not destroy the method.
